description: Get Summary of Deposits data (branch-level domestic deposits, annual as of June 30, 1994 onward). With cert only: the institution's branches and its deposit market share in each state where it has offices. With a geography (state, county, city, ZIP, or MSA code): every institution in that market ranked by deposits, with market share and the Herfindahl-Hirschman index. With both: the institution's branches in that market and its rank and share there. Defaults to the latest survey year. Dollar amounts are in thousands.

cert.description: FDIC certificate number, from fdic_search_institutions. Alone: its branches and per-state share. With a geography: its position in that market.

city.description: Branch city as FDIC spells it (Seattle, St. Louis), up to 50 characters; matched exactly as given or in title case, with a hyphen, apostrophe, or space between words also tried the other ways FDIC records it (Winston-Salem finds Winston Salem); requires state.

county.description: County as FDIC spells it (King, not King County — a trailing " County" is stripped), up to 50 characters; matched exactly as given or in title case, with a hyphen, apostrophe, or space between words also tried the other ways FDIC records it; requires state.

limit.description: Branches or ranked institutions returned inline (1–200). A larger set is also staged whole as a dataframe when this deployment stages dataframes.

msa_code.description: Five-digit CBSA (metropolitan area) code, 10180–49740; branch rows from a state-level call carry msa_code values to reuse. Non-metropolitan branches have no code.

state.description: Branch state: two-letter code in any case or full name.

year.description: Survey year (deposits as of June 30), 1994 on. Omit for the latest survey.

zip.description: Five-digit branch ZIP code; leading zeros kept (02110).

name: fdic_get_deposits

branches.description: Institution modes: branches in scope, main office first (preview).

items.description: One branch; an optional field is absent when FDIC holds no value for it.

branch_id.description: FDIC unique branch number, stable across survey years.

branch_number.description: Institution's own branch number; 0 is the main office.

county.description: County name as FDIC records it, e.g. King.

deposits.description: Deposits booked at the branch, USD thousands (booking, not where customers live).

msa_code.description: Five-digit CBSA code, reusable as msa_code; absent for a non-metropolitan branch.

msa_name.description: Metropolitan area name; absent for a non-metropolitan branch.

cap.description: The limit applied to the preview.

data_as_of.description: When FDIC last rebuilt the Summary of Deposits index (ISO timestamp).

dataset.description: The staged full collection; present only when it exceeded the preview and this deployment staged it as a dataframe.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_scope`: Neither cert nor any geography (state, county, city, zip, msa_code) given. `location_requires_state`: county or city given without state. `invalid_state`: state is not a US state, DC, or territory code or name. `year_not_available`: year is after the latest survey in the index. `pacer_shed`: This server's shared FDIC request queue is saturated and the call would wait past its budget. `upstream_rate_limited`: FDIC answered 429 and retries were exhausted. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

footprint.description: Institution mode: its deposits and share per state, largest first.

deposits.description: Its branch deposits in the state, USD thousands.

market_share_pct.description: Its share of the state market, percent; null when the market holds none.

state_market_deposits.description: All branch deposits in the state, USD thousands.

geography.description: The geography as applied; absent in institution mode.

county.description: County name as applied, with any trailing " County" removed.

institution.description: The institution; present when it reported branches in scope.

branch_count.description: Its branches in the queried scope.

deposits_in_scope.description: Sum of its branch deposits in the queried scope, USD thousands (domestic, June 30) — not the Call Report's total_deposits.

name.description: Institution name as filed for the survey year.

institutions.description: Market mode: institutions ranked by deposits (preview).

deposits.description: Deposits in the market, USD thousands.

market_share_pct.description: Market share, percent; null when the market holds no deposits.

name.description: Current name, or the name at closing, from the institution record; absent when no record carries the CERT.

market.description: Market modes: the whole market in the geography.

deposits.description: All branch deposits in the market, USD thousands.

hhi.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman index over every institution: the sum of squared percentage shares (0–10,000); null when the market holds no deposits.

institution_count.description: Institutions with branches in the market.

mode.description: institution (cert only), market (geography only), or institution_in_market (both).

notice.description: Guidance when nothing matched, or where the full collection is staged.

position.description: institution_in_market: present when the institution has branches in the market.

deposits.description: Its deposits in the market, USD thousands.

market_share_pct.description: Its market share, percent; null when the market holds no deposits.

rank.description: Rank by deposits in the market; 1 = largest.

total_rows.description: Full count of the branches (institution modes) or ranked institutions (market).

truncated.description: True when the preview holds fewer rows than total_rows.

year_defaulted.description: True when year was omitted and the latest survey was used.

title: Get Summary of Deposits branches and market share
